profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer and leader hoping to build things that help those in need.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: Quilt was the perfect place for me to grow into a front end developer. Not only did I get to experience the fast-paced, wear-many-hats culture of a startup and the complexity of a customer-centric, fully-automated, online insurance product, I also got to architect and build large projects, including the integration of a new CRM (HubSpot) and platform (React.js) on our Rails application. In a short amount of time, I was maintaining our front end engineering (client-side JavaScript, CSS, and HTML), including the implementation of a styleguide (in collaboration with contracted designers). I am forever grateful for my team for trusting me with a large amount of responsibility and for involving me in everything from company culture to marketing, product, business development, and more.

positions.title: Jr Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description: Launch Academy is a 10-week immersive bootcamp through which I developed programming skills to become a professional web developer.  I thrived thanks to the excellent teaching and the program's commitment to a culture of mental/emotional health and professionalism. I have gained a number of skills including pair programming and collaborative development, Agile methodologies, TDD, OOP, Git workflow, and continuous integration.

positions.title: Bible Course Teacher
positions.description: Harvard Christian Faith and Action (HCFA) is the Harvard chapter of Christian Union, a global campus ministry organization committed to the development of our next leaders. HCFA is as much intellectual as it is spiritual, a balanced approach to developing its students into people who value relational harmony, excellence in their work, self-knowledge and health, social justice, generosity, and much more. I have had the privilege of teaching a group of 11 senior men with whom I have explored topics including an in-depth, rational approach to studying the Bible, spiritual practices of meditation and prayer, vocational preparation, and more.

positions.title: Therapeutic Mentor/Youth Support Group Leader

- Developed trust with mentee and plan activities with mentee and parents

projects.title: Take On Meme
projects.description:
Github: https://github.com/shinyoungleeee/review-site

'Take On Meme' is a React-Rails app that I created with four peer developers at Launch Academy, in which users can review today's most popular memes. Memes are curated by admins to ensure users see only the best content. Users can upvote or downvote meme reviews dynamically as a fun way to highlight good content and foster interaction between users. The Rails back end serves up internal API endpoints, which are accessed by React on the front end to create a seamless, dynamic experience. The front end also features styling using Foundation and Sass.

If the currency of internet humor is ridiculousness, then a meme is a blank check, and boy have we spent lavishly. Chances are that enabling users to review memes will only exacerbate the issue, but we did it anyway. At least we had fun doing it!

projects.title: tape
projects.description:
Github: https://github.com/shinyoungleeee/tape

'tape' is a platform for sharing music across different streaming services. Searching for albums dynamically populates links to available streaming services using Spotify and iTunes APIs. Liking an album automatically creates user collections, which can be viewed collectively in groups that users can create and/or join. The Rails back end handles querying API data for album info, art, and URLs without creating repeats. The front end integrates React.js, Chart.js, Foundation, and Webkit for a dynamic and visually appealing user interface.

One of my favorite hobbies is going out on a beautiful day to listen to a great record on my own. Music streaming apps like Spotify and Apple Music have greatly increased the ease and joy of this experience. But when I find a gem, it's irresistible to share it! There's just something special about sharing great music with friends. I created 'tape' to bridge that gap.
